causalAutopsy.notes: The durable exception scanner used a shared callback that initiated one topic notice for each historical reply without new conversational authority. PR2819 quiets this producer only in enforcing mode; it does not change the scanner and was absent from the reported running version. The fix removes egress from scan reconciliation while preserving live failure reporting.

classClosure.reason: The only remaining notice send is the existing one-shot live failure callback for an original conversational send. The historical self-triggered scan is changed to a strictly record-only operation with zero notify actions, including repeated scans and restart; no controller, retry, spawn or recovery loop is added.
